revisionReason: The user still cannot quickly understand the data-watch update status.
sourceRequest: 근데 아직도 가독성이 많이 떨어져서 내가 현황파악하기가 쉽지않아.
outcome: Make data-watch readable at a glance with human data names, concise last-data dates and concrete missing-update or inspection actions; deploy the reviewed presentation to the existing runtime.
constraints: Keep the existing date axes, source checkpoints and conservative freshness decisions unchanged.
Merge display items only when their data date, state and problem agree; never hide a divergent or failed member.
Keep published-source gaps, age-only investigation hints and date-reading failures visibly distinct.
Daily status omits file replacement dates and empty frozen-research checks; the full list retains data dates and file replacement dates.
Use stored bounded observation receipts and read-only Slack verification; do not read or expose credentials.
Apply only reviewed data-watch presentation files over each production service's current source; preserve all other running service images and policies.
Do not replay uncertain Slack writes or claim a real owner-command E2E was tested when it was not.

deliverables.description: Short daily status, grouped human dataset list and clear incident text
acceptance: The actual 38-dataset production snapshot renders a daily status below 1300 characters with distinct action sections and no internal dataset keys.
Matching KRX dates and duplicated SEC FSDS dates are combined; differing dates or failure states remain visible.
The on-demand list shows all 38 datasets using human names, data dates and file replacement dates under source headings.
Failed or initial catalog states label cached data honestly; age-only hints never assert a missing published period.
Correct-date-axis, future-date, divergent-group and failed-catalog regressions pass.
Data-watch tests use real PostgreSQL and Temporal where available; simulated Slack is labelled separately.
Ruff, repository diff checks and CI pass.

deliverables.description: Guarded operational application and actual delivery evidence
acceptance: Production data-watch worker, API and Slack ingress render the reviewed presentation while preserving their other source files and settings.
Actual new daily message matches PostgreSQL outbox and Slack readback receipts.
Remaining real-owner on-demand verification boundary is stated explicitly.

nonGoals: Upstream ingest repair or source calendar redesign
stopConditions: Do not deploy across a changed production baseline without fresh comparison.
Do not claim actual Slack delivery without matching durable receipts.
